capability: Your GSTIN, legal name and state
reference_note: Invoice Ninja has a generic VAT number field
ours_note: Settings validate GSTIN format and checksum, store legal name and derive the state. A blank GSTIN means unregistered.
rationale: Validate the format and checksum, take the state from the first two digits, and print legal name and GSTIN on every tax invoice.

capability: Client GSTIN with validation and state
ours_note: Customer GSTIN is validated on create and update and sets the state. Unregistered clients carry a billing state.
rationale: A blank GSTIN means an unregistered client. A filled one must pass the checksum and sets the client's state.

capability: IGST or CGST/SGST chosen from place of supply
ours_note: Editor preselects IGST or CGST+SGST from seller and place-of-supply state. An override needs a reason, stored with both states on the invoice snapshot.
rationale: Compare your state with the client's and preselect the split. Allow an override with a reason. See the GST rules tab.

capability: GST and non-GST clients and documents
reference_note: Khatabook offers GST and non-GST bills
ours_note: Title is Tax Invoice or Bill of Supply and is snapshotted; GSTR-1 section separates them. An unregistered seller can still issue invoices that carry GST.
rationale: Print "Bill of Supply" when nothing is taxable or you are not registered, and "Tax Invoice" otherwise. Report the two separately.

capability: HSN/SAC code per service and line
reference_note: Invoice Ninja needs a custom field
ours_note: Services and invoice lines carry a validated HSN/SAC code, required on taxable Tax Invoice lines. GSTR-1 HSN summary export added.
rationale: Tax invoices need SAC codes, and GSTR-1 needs an HSN summary.

capability: Amount in words and round-off line
ours_note: Not in the PDF writer
rationale: Expected on Indian invoices. Round to the rupee and show the round-off.

ours_note: One GSTIN per tenant
rationale: SaaS customers with branches in several states need a GSTIN and number series per branch inside one tenant.

capability: Reverse charge, exempt, nil-rated and zero-rated lines
rationale: Add tax categories to the line when a client needs them. Exports and SEZ need an LUT number.

reference_note: Invoice Ninja supports EU e-invoicing only
rationale: Mandatory only above the IRP turnover threshold. Check your own turnover, then use a GSP API.

capability: PDF that prints exactly what you designed
reference_note: Invoice Ninja renders HTML with headless Chrome
ours_note: ASCII-only writer. ₹ prints as "?". Logo, stamp and signature are not drawn.
rationale: Render the same HTML as the on-screen preview to PDF, so every format prints as designed.

reference_note: Invoice Ninja has a design editor. Khatabook offers a few fixed themes.
ours_note: One text template with {{placeholders}}. The preview returns text and the PDF ignores it.
rationale: Pick a base layout, switch blocks on or off (HSN, bank details, UPI QR, signature, terms), set colour and logo, and see a live preview. Save named formats.

capability: Default format per client or document type
reference_note: Invoice Ninja sets this per client and group
rationale: Clients in different businesses expect different layouts. Set a default per client and allow an override per invoice.

ours_note: Uploaded and stored, but not drawn on the PDF
rationale: Fixed as part of the PDF work.

capability: UPI QR and bank details on the invoice
rationale: The quickest way for clients to pay. A UPI QR that carries the amount needs no payment gateway.

capability: Custom fields and columns (PO number, site, vehicle)
rationale: The cheapest way to absorb client quirks. Start with a client PO number.

capability: Line items with quantity, rate and GST
reference_note: Autumn creates lines from the plan
ours_note: Add and remove rows, GST per row, tested end to end
rationale: Done. Add item search from the catalogue.

capability: Discounts per line and per invoice
reference_note: Autumn has coupons
ours_note: No discount field on lines
rationale: Common in negotiated B2B deals. Discount before tax, shown on the line.

capability: Locked invoices with correction and void
ours_note: Issued invoices keep a snapshot. Correction flow and void with a reason.
rationale: Stricter than the references, which is right for GST.

capability: Number series per financial year and document type
ours_note: Tenant prefix and unique number. No yearly reset.
rationale: GST needs one series per year, e.g. INV/26-27/0001. Bills of Supply and credit notes need their own series.

reference_note: Autumn handles refunds and credits through Stripe
ours_note: Only a write-off on a payment
rationale: Reducing an issued GST invoice needs a credit note. A write-off hides the change from GSTR-1.

capability: Bulk invoice runs and bulk download
ours_note: Bulk runs that respect each contract's schedule
rationale: Month-end work. Becomes the scheduled subscription run.

ours_note: Draft quotes with PDF. No conversion.
rationale: An accepted quote should become a subscription without re-typing lines.
Signed agreement and work-completion proof. Needs file storage.

capability: Subscriptions with cycle, escalation and renewal notice
reference_note: Neither reference has escalation or notice periods
ours_note: Frequency, invoice months, cycle day, escalation %, renewal notice, deposit
rationale: Your core. It becomes the subscription record in the new model.

ours_note: Each contract has its own services and value
rationale: Becomes an override on a standard plan.

capability: Plan catalogue (e.g. ERP Standard, ERP Plus, AMC)
ours_note: Services priced per frequency. No bundles.
rationale: Shows what each client buys in one place and makes price changes a catalogue edit.

capability: Plan features and limits (modules, users, branches)
rationale: The basis for the check API and for billing by seat.

capability: Upgrade, downgrade and mid-cycle changes with proration
ours_note: The contract is edited by hand. No proration.
rationale: Clients add modules or users mid-term. Put the prorated difference on the next invoice instead of working it out by hand.

capability: Pause, cancel at end of term, scheduled end
ours_note: Contracts can be set inactive. No pause or scheduled end.
rationale: Stops the run from billing a client who has given notice.

ours_note: The dashboard has revenue and outstanding amounts
rationale: MRR and next-90-day renewals are the two numbers to watch.

ours_note: Quantity on lines only
rationale: Many ERP subscriptions are priced per user. Bill the quantity from the entitlement count.

ours_note: Escalation per contract only
rationale: Raise list prices without changing existing clients until renewal.

reference_note: Autumn track
rationale: Only if a client is billed by usage. Ask before building.
For support-hour packs or SMS credits, drawn down as used.

ours_note: Renewals register
rationale: Add an email to you before each notice date.

ours_note: Held and settled, with settlements
rationale: Already built. Leave it alone unless a client uses it.

capability: One-off charges on the next invoice
ours_note: Additional services register
rationale: Also where ERPs can push billable work.
Useful only if you pilot new modules with clients.

capability: Self-serve checkout for a tenant's own clients
rationale: Tenants' clients sign agreements and pay invoices. For selling the SaaS itself, see the SaaS area.

capability: Multi-tenant data model and superadmin console
ours_note: Tenant-scoped tables, tenant manager with create, rename, suspend, reactivate and history, tenant admin user management with a last-admin guard. Superadmin cannot manage a tenant's users or switch into a tenant; archive state not modelled.
rationale: This is what makes selling it possible. Keep it.
notes: superadmin is still not built well needs fixing. dsnt function as intended,

ours_note: Route-level tests prove every API route rejects another tenant's ids. Two known email-uniqueness leaks are tracked.
rationale: One leaked invoice ends a SaaS business. Add tests that every route rejects another tenant's ids.

capability: Demo business per industry with realistic data
reference_note: Invoice Ninja ships a demo account
ours_note: Five demo tenants. Only Nexio has clients, contracts and invoices seeded.
rationale: Seed each demo with its own clients, plans, invoice format and GST mix: a CA firm, a gym, an analytics agency, a sports academy, a software house. This becomes the sales demo.

ours_note: Tenants are created by the superadmin
rationale: Sign up, enter GSTIN and pick a business type, and get a format and catalogue preset for that type. Not needed while you onboard by hand.

capability: Bill your tenants on plans with limits (dogfooding)
reference_note: Autumn exists to do exactly this
rationale: Once plans and entitlements exist, add a plan for tenants (invoices per month, users, formats) and invoice them from your own tenant.

capability: Tenant data export and account closure
rationale: SaaS buyers ask how they can leave. A full CSV and PDF archive answers it.

capability: Card or UPI autopay for your SaaS subscription
rationale: Invoice tenants by hand at first. Add UPI autopay or Razorpay subscriptions once there are more than a handful.

capability: Tenant branding on emails and public links
ours_note: Logo, stamp and signature per tenant
rationale: Sender name and links in the tenant's own name. Custom domains can wait.

reference_note: Khatabook is built around this
ours_note: Invoices and payments are listed separately. No running balance.
rationale: One balance per client with every invoice, payment, credit note and note in date order. It also produces the statement.
The first thing a client's accounts team asks for. Generated from the ledger.

reference_note: Neither reference handles TDS
ours_note: Method, reference, TDS, write-off, editable with ledger kept
rationale: Specific to India and already built.

ours_note: Current, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 and 90+ days
rationale: Your collections workspace.

capability: Payment reminders, including one-tap for all overdue
reference_note: Khatabook sends by SMS and WhatsApp. Autumn handles failed payments.
ours_note: Reminder is recorded but never sent
rationale: Email first, plus a WhatsApp share link. Schedule before-due and overdue reminders.

capability: Overdue escalation with optional ERP restriction
ours_note: Aging report and manual reminders
rationale: Reminders at 7 and 15 days, notice at 30, and ERP restriction at 45 only if the client agreement allows it.
Start with the UPI QR. Add Razorpay only if a client asks to pay by card.

ours_note: A payment must match one invoice
rationale: Needed when one transfer pays several invoices or a client pays ahead.

ours_note: TDS amount captured only
rationale: Port cwerp's logic later.
CSV import with suggested matches covers most of the value.

ours_note: SMTP settings stored. The test says no email was sent.
rationale: One transactional provider, PDF attached, and a delivery log per invoice.

ours_note: Channel recorded only
rationale: A signed public link to the invoice plus a prefilled wa.me message. Costs nothing and needs no WhatsApp Business API.
Each message has a cost and templates need approval. Confirm the manual share link isn't enough first.
Start with signed read-only links. A login portal can wait.

reference_note: Khatabook creates a bill in seconds
ours_note: Invoice dialog with line rows and client picker
rationale: Start from the client's plan or last invoice, add items by search, work from the keyboard, and preview beside the form.

capability: Design tokens and complete control states
ours_note: globals.css and a small ui.tsx kit
rationale: Default, hover, focus, disabled, loading and error states on every control. One button and form vocabulary on every screen.

capability: Helpful empty states and skeleton loading
ours_note: Route-level loading.tsx only
rationale: Each empty list should say what goes there and offer the first action.

reference_note: Khatabook is mobile-first
ours_note: Tested at 360px
rationale: Keep the 360px tests. Put the ledger, share and record-payment actions within thumb reach.

ours_note: Not audited
rationale: Run an audit, fix contrast and focus order, and add an automated check to the Playwright suite.

ours_note: English only
rationale: Invoices are read in English. If you sell to small shops, Hindi in the app becomes worth doing.

capability: Client master with business type and tags
ours_note: Company, one contact, GSTIN, address. No business type.
rationale: Your clients run different businesses. A type field drives default formats and reports.

capability: Several contacts and CC on emails
ours_note: One contact per client
rationale: Finance and the owner often both want the invoice.

capability: Service catalogue with prices per frequency
ours_note: Monthly, quarterly, half-yearly and annual prices
rationale: Becomes the building block for plans.

ours_note: Monthly GST sales with CSV export
rationale: Extend it with B2B, B2CS and B2CL sections, an HSN summary, and nil, exempt and non-GST supplies.
Most Indian small businesses, and their accountants, use Tally. A voucher XML export removes double entry and helps sell the SaaS.

ours_note: Dashboard page
rationale: Add MRR, renewals due and days to collect.

capability: Revenue by client, plan and business type
ours_note: GST sales and pending payments only
rationale: Two or three fixed reports. No report builder.

capability: Export everything to CSV or Excel
ours_note: GST and payments downloads
rationale: For your accountant and for audits.

capability: Entitlement check API for client ERPs
reference_note: Autumn check
rationale: Each ERP asks "is this module on, and how many users are left". Licence rules stop living in six codebases.

capability: API with tokens per client ERP
ours_note: Internal routes, cookie auth only
rationale: Needed for check, track and pushing billable work.

capability: Webhooks (invoice issued, payment recorded, plan changed)
rationale: Signed and retried. Only once an ERP needs to react.

capability: CSV import for clients, subscriptions and open invoices
rationale: With 5–10 clients you can type them in. Import matters if you take over an existing book.

capability: Billing as the licence and invoice source for all ERPs
ours_note: A standalone app today
rationale: A strategic call. Write an ADR on which ERPs adopt it and where the accounting ledger lives.

ours_note: Demo identity picker. The cookie is the raw user id. Passwords are stored in plain text.
rationale: Blocks real use. Reuse the pattern from servez or PrepVault.
notes: demo mode keeps current behavior. can byuild real login and session as well.

ours_note: One SQLite file, schema created on start
rationale: Managed Postgres gives durability and backups.

ours_note: Docker image, compose with staging and production, Caddy, health check and manual deploy workflow exist. Built and smoke-tested locally only; never run against a Hetzner host. Database is still SQLite.
rationale: Use the same target as the other apps.
notes: we will use hetzner and keep similar flow like nexio_stock + cwerp

ours_note: Everything runs on click
rationale: Subscription runs, reminders and dunning depend on it.
notes: lets also keep enable disable of schedule including manual as well

ours_note: Contract and tenant events only
rationale: Who changed an invoice, payment or plan, when, and why.

ours_note: Seed snapshot only
rationale: Comes with managed Postgres. Rehearse a restore once.

ours_note: Vitest and 20 Playwright specs, no CI workflow
rationale: The tests exist. Run them on every PR.

ours_note: superadmin, admin and user
rationale: Enough for a small team. Check that every route enforces them on the server.

ours_note: INR only
rationale: Only if you bill a client abroad.
Not part of invoicing your clients.
Belongs in the ERPs.

ours_note: Follow-up task notes only
rationale: Keep task notes for collections follow-up.

ours_note: Web app manifest, icons and theme colour make it installable. No service worker, nothing cached.
rationale: Responsive web is enough. Add a PWA manifest if you want a home-screen icon.
Tally covers your accounting.
